summary: Slow-starting mercenary civ. Byzantines chain Cisterns next to resources, hire javelin or longbow mercenaries in Feudal, and hit a Castle spike with free mercenaries from the Golden Horn Tower.
openings: Sheep start with 2 on stone and 1 on gold, Grand Winery Feudal around 2:30 to 2:40, javelins around 5:50, then a push with about 8 javelins or 10 longbows plus spears.
Against a spear rush they hold 5 villagers on wood for a barracks and make 5 to 7 spears.

spikes.label: Mercenary push
spikes.detail: Around 6 minutes they push with javelin or longbow mercenaries and spears, sometimes with a single ram.
spikes.answer: Archers and spears; keep map control so they are forced onto farms early.

spikes.label: Golden Horn Tower
spikes.detail: The Golden Horn Tower gives a free batch of mercenaries every 90 seconds. Their Castle army is cataphracts, javelins and spears with monks.
spikes.answer: Mass spearmen is the only real counter to that army; they answer with springalds.

scout: Grand Winery as their Feudal landmark
Cisterns chained next to their resources
A barracks held back until they see yours means they expect a spear rush

pairings.why: Their standard Castle army, with monks for healing.

winConditions.detail: Free mercenaries from the Golden Horn Tower in Castle.
Cisterns make their base strong once set up.

howToBeat: Spear or tower rushes punish the slow setup.
Take map control so they are forced onto farms early.
Chinese tax pressure, French extra scouts and a Japanese spear rush into units are all built to punish them.
